title: Persona, Goals, Knowledge, Belief & Actor-Context Authoring
objective: Add NPC/creature persona, goals, knowledge, belief and actor-context proposal authoring over the stable MNCS candidate, identity/origin and fast-generation layers without taking relationship, reputation, world-state or owner-domain authority.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded persona, motivation/goal, knowledge/belief and actor-context proposal authoring plus life-context projections while preserving owner-domain truth and the completed MNCS-01/04/05 contracts.
scope.completion_gate: A creator can author persona, goals, knowledge, beliefs and actor context as explicit proposals/projections without silently changing canonical entity, world, relationship, reputation or owner-domain truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.2.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-05 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-05-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-06 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
MNCS-01 remains stable candidate/constraint/lock authority, MNCS-04 remains identity/origin proposal authority, and MNCS-05 remains fast-generation adapter authority.
MIB-09 relationship and reputation remain owner-domain authority; MNCS-06 may reference but not mutate those records.
Knowledge and belief are actor-context proposals/projections and must distinguish what an actor knows, believes, suspects, or does not know from objective world truth.
Life-context projections do not create a second biography, relationship, reputation, world-state or canonical event ledger.

MNCS-06 is governed-started on branch work/mncs-06-persona-goals-knowledge-belief-context from application main a0a44f6ddec620aae87b4cb27b2d251d1ad3b2c5; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-04 in_progress and is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Establish causal RED for persona/goals/knowledge/belief/actor-context proposal authoring, epistemic separation from objective truth, relationship/reputation reference-only behavior, unresolved-safe life context and local-first operation; then implement only bounded MNCS-06 behavior through validation, serialized publication and closeout.
